pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
notes: drawn moving screen-left (aim fixed, -90 deg); moving screen-right: flip_h this sheet and negate upper_offset.x and head_offset.x
upper body: the game's idle clip (girl_idle_<mood>_*, no twist) moved by upper_offset; the head pose moves by head_offset (= upper_offset) plus the idle frame's own head_offset
frames 1 and 4 are half-way: the lead boot is under her arm; frame 3 holds frame 2's boots (the open stance)
